cards.text: WEEKENDER — EUROPEAN TRAVEL / FOUR-COLOR WOMEN

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Same European Travel Tight ad with the opening grid revised to four women carrying Weekender: Cognac top-left, Army Green top-right, Dark Chocolate bottom-left and Black bottom-right. Four aspirational outfits make the styling promise readable immediately. The exact script, Woman Over 40 Eleven v3 Natural voice at existing 1.1× speed, Avatar V guide, 76 captions, tightened pauses, city examples and final CTA are preserved.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: If you're going to Europe this fall, here's how I'd style one beautiful travel bag for Paris, Milan and London. Three different looks, without buying a whole new wardrobe for every stop.
Four distinct photographed women: tan, black, taupe and burgundy Birkin-family bags. 2×2 source-photo grid with persistent lower-left P01 guide.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Four distinct attractive looks immediately establish European travel aspiration and the range of bag styling. Simultaneous juxtaposition makes variety readable before the named Eleanor reveal. Hold the grid through the full hook; no spinning/panel transitions.

First frame. Hold through every stop; hard cut on This is at frame 285. Direct background cuts. Existing voice, guide and caption timing retained.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: This is the Eleanor Weekender from Velantra. I'd go for Cognac.
Cognac Eleanor nearly frontal in a lived-in apartment entry, daylight, slightly off-axis phone photo. Selected revised asset.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: That warm leather against the light canvas gives you such a beautiful starting point for your travel outfits.
Close phone view of cognac leather/canvas junction and real horizontal gold hardware, natural uneven light. Selected revised asset.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Starting with Paris, I'd keep everything relaxed. Straight-leg jeans, a cream knit, a trench and loafers. Then carry the Eleanor by the top handles. The bag gives those simple pieces a more finished look, even when you're just arriving at your hotel.
Different woman: short dark bob, cream knit, straight jeans, trench, loafers, carrying Eleanor at a modest Paris hotel entrance, friend-shot framing. Selected revised asset.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
The whole outfit demonstrates each Paris suggestion and lets the bag finish familiar clothes. Small step/coat adjustment supports arrival context. Proposed single 110% stepped crop on Then carry, anchored on the bag and handles; keep presenter fixed.

Cut wide on Starting with Paris; retain source 110% stepped crop at frame 733 on Then carry. Direct background cuts. Existing voice, guide and caption timing retained.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: For Milan, I'd dress it up. Tailored trousers, a fitted knit, a long coat,
Different white woman: shoulder-length chestnut waves, charcoal tailored trousers, fitted dark knit and long camel coat, leaning casually outside a Milan cafe, Eleanor held. Selected revised asset.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:

Cut on For Milan to the original motion clip; keep the three already-tightened source intervals. Direct background cuts. Existing voice, guide and caption timing retained.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: and a little gold jewelry to pick up the hardware. The same bag suddenly feels much more polished because of what you've put around it.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: And for London, I'd have a little more fun. A checked jacket, relaxed trousers, comfortable sneakers. Let the textures do the work. The canvas and leather sit so nicely alongside those autumn layers.
New copper-haired woman seated on a station-exterior bench, checked jacket, relaxed trousers and sneakers; hand grips Eleanor handles before pickup.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
The checks and relaxed stance demonstrate London texture and personality. Keep shoes and bag readable; a single stepped crop on textures may show jacket/canvas relationship, never counted as new B-roll.

Cut on And for London; retain still through frame 1299, native motion from 1300, and original internal angle changes. Direct background cuts. Existing voice, guide and caption timing retained.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: That's what I like about building your travel wardrobe around a bag like this. You can change the whole mood with your clothes, and your weekender still feels like part of the outfit.
Fresh everyday wardrobe-rail still with Eleanor and three clothing groups; use natural window light, imperfect spacing. Selected revised asset.

cards.title: EMOTION

The arrangement collects the styling principle after three different women demonstrate it. It offers a face-free visual reset without replaying any earlier source.

Cut to the wardrobe rail on That's what I like; reset to a face-free composition. Direct background cuts. Existing voice, guide and caption timing retained.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Because the outfit you wear between cities deserves just as much thought as the one you wear when you get there.
New silver-haired woman at train doorway, navy coat and scarf, holding Eleanor while adjusting her scarf.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
A new person and journey context carry the between-cities payoff. The visible coat adjustment ties comfort to looking put together, without a capacity or airline claim.

Cut on Because the outfit; retain original train-door motion. Direct background cuts. Existing voice, guide and caption timing retained.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: So, Paris, Milan or London—which look would you wear? Shop the Eleanor Weekender at Velantra.
Fresh Cognac Eleanor on a plain wood chair beside a window with a scarf draped over chair back, casual phone product photo. Selected revised asset; retain O01 closing graphic.

cards.title: EMOTION

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: OPENING COLOR ORDER
cards.text: Cognac / Army Green across the top. Dark Chocolate / Black across the bottom. The raised Dark Chocolate bag clears the original lower-left guide. Opening holds 0–9.5 seconds, then cuts to the existing Cognac product view.

cards.title: ORIGINAL PACE PRESERVED
cards.text: No additional speed change: Eleven v3 Natural was already generated at 1.1×. All 28 retained audio intervals and 76 caption phrases remain intact. The final audio is byte-identical to the source; no internal quiet gaps of 0.2 seconds or longer were detected at −40 dB. The short ending hold remains.

cards.title: STYLING SEQUENCE
cards.text: Four-color inspiration → Cognac choice → leather and canvas detail → Paris outfit → Milan outfit and jewelry detail → London textures → wardrobe summary → between-cities payoff → shop invitation. The four opening looks inspire; Paris, Milan and London remain the three narrated city demonstrations.

cards.title: FINAL MEDIA VERIFIED
cards.text: All 2,120 frames decoded. All 1,835 body frames after the opening matched the exact source within normal re-encoding variation. Consecutive cut frames, the opening at full size, presenter clearance and final CTA inspected. No measured campaign performance is claimed.
